newsitem.title: USA: Banc One Capital, Boston Financial in pact.
newsitem.headline: Banc One Capital, Boston Financial in pact.

text.p: Banc One Capital Corp, the investment and merchant banking arm of Banc One Corp, and Boston Financial said on Monday they planned to form a strategic pact, with Banc One investing in Boston Financial.
The companies also said they would explore the possibility of leveraging their real estate investment banking and investment capabilities.
Boston Financial is a privately-owned diversified real estate investment firm.

"This strategic alliance will add significantly to Banc One's effort to build a comprehensive real estate strategy in a collaborative way," David Meuse, chairman and chief executive of Banc One Capital Holdings, said.
Banc One Capital said it would make a non-voting investment in Boston Financial to provide the firm with additional working capital which would be used to significantly expand its business.
The deal was expected to be completed by the end of July.
